<thought>Based on the most intense peak at m/z ≈ 199, which likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral molecular mass is about 198 Da. A plausible formula matching this exact mass is C₁₀H₁₄O₄ (monoisotopic mass ≈ 198.089 Da), which fits the observed mass within typical experimental tolerance.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H14O4</final_answer>
